before: A new list instance used the marker kind of its first item on every level, so an inserted numbered list nested in a bullet list became bullets.
after: Each level of a new list instance gets the marker kind its items request. Mixed instances get their own numbering definition.
reason: Executor-only change. It writes the same setListNumbering operations and numbering part elements as styled lists. Operation payloads, collaboration schemas, shared state, and transport remain unchanged.
